asset.name: CopyIconButton
asset.description: An icon button that copies text, confirms by morphing its icon to a check in the success colour, and announces the result.

requires.reason: Surface, size, shape, tap target and the icon morph are IconButton's; this asset adds only the copy and its result.
Success and failure colours resolve to the semantic status tokens.

rationale: Copy was rebuilt by hand on every surface that offered it, each with a different subset of fallback, feedback, colour and announcement; the result is decided once here.
